preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes n must be between 1 and 80000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pairs of paths that do not share any common nodes.
